description: Defines the interface for a DMA-buf VideoFrame pool used in media GPU processing on ChromeOS, including methods for initialization, frame management, and thread safety.

classes.name: DmabufVideoFramePool
classes.description: Interface for managing DMA-buf VideoFrames, including initialization, frame retrieval, and thread safety.

methods.name: set_parent_task_runner
methods.description: Sets the task runner on which public methods should be called.

methods.name: AsPlatformVideoFramePool
methods.description: Allows safe downcasting to a platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Configures the pool with format, size, and frame limits; returns buffer layout or error.

methods.name: GetFrame
methods.description: Retrieves a frame from the pool or nullptr if exhausted.

methods.name: IsExhausted
methods.description: Checks if the pool has reached maximum capacity.

methods.name: NotifyWhenFrameAvailable
methods.description: Sets a callback to notify when frames become available.

methods.name: ReleaseAllFrames
methods.description: Releases all allocated frames, causing reallocation.

methods.name: GetGpuBufferLayout
methods.description: Returns layout details of allocated buffers after successful initialization.

methods.name: IsFakeVideoFramePool
methods.description: Indicates if the pool is a mock used for testing.
